headline: France's Control Breaks Paraguay's Defensive Stranglehold
story: France swarmed the pitch from start, but Paraguay's rigid 5-4-1 formation—a defensive wall—kept them at bay through 69 minutes. The Parisians controlled 67 per cent possession with 3.2 high-press phases, yet breakthrough proved elusive. Paraguay, defending with absolute commitment, scraped five shots without troubling the target. The dam burst in the 70th minute: France's mounting pressure yielded a clinical finish, built on 0.79 xG.

The xG gap told all: France's 1.93 to Paraguay's 0.13 reflected overwhelming control. With 15 shots against five, France's press forced 37 turnovers while recovering in 8 seconds—Paraguay's 20.5 showed the gulf. Mbappe (7.9) and Doué (7.6) drove attacks; Mauricio and Gill held heroically for the home side. A scrambled save in the 90th minute denied France a second, but one conversion sufficed against such toothless opposition.

keyMoment.text: France breached Paraguay's defensive wall with clinical finishing, built on superior possession and press phases.

home.verdict: Defensive discipline postponed the inevitable; without attacking threat, the wall crumbles.
points: Zero shots on target and 0.13 xG—Paraguay offered nothing going forward, handing France total control.
Ball recovery time of 20.5 seconds versus France's 8 allowed 37 forced turnovers; Paraguay chased ghosts.
The 5-4-1 prioritised survival but needed one dangerous moment to trouble Saliba (7.4) and disrupt France's certainty.

away.verdict: Possession and press dominance converted once; a late miss hinted at vulnerability.
points: 67 per cent possession and 3.2 high-press phases built an overwhelming framework; 70th-minute finish justified the blueprint.
Mbappe (7.9) and Doué (7.6) orchestrated 8-second possession cycles and 37 forced turnovers—France's press left Paraguay in retreat.
A saved big chance (0.21 xG) at 90+6 reminded France how narrow the margin was; clinical efficiency proved decisive.

statLine: France's 1.93 expected goals against Paraguay's 0.13 encapsulated a 15-fold gulf in control—five-to-15 shots, eight-to-20-second recovery times, and the single strike that separated tournament contenders from defensive castaways.
